The total credit is $24,600, all as credits on their December invoices and no cash. I can't confirm it has actually been posted to the November books yet.

**What they're getting:**
- **Loomly:** $18,400 [2]
- **Pinecrest Rentals:** $6,200 [2]

This equals 100% of each customer's November platform fees. Rachel's first idea was 50%, but she raised it on Nov 13 after Loomly pushed back. Loomly had 1,312 of the 1,840 late payouts, and some of its sellers were charged overdraft fees [5]. Rachel has already told Pinecrest about the $6,200 credit, and their CFO thanked her [8].

**November books:**
- Marcus decided on Nov 17 to accrue the $24,600 in November as a reduction of revenue, not as an operating expense. Jenna is to post the journal entry, and it gets reversed when the December credit memos go out [2].
- The latest status I found is the Nov 16 close checklist, which lists this accrual as "In progress" under Marcus [7]. Nothing I found says Jenna has posted the entry. Check with her or in the ledger.
- November close locks Dec 7 [2].

**Still open:** Loomly also asked to be reimbursed for overdraft fees: $7,690 for 214 sellers. Marcus and Rachel haven't decided yet, and Loomly was told it would get an answer by Nov 25 [1]. Marcus is leaving it out of the November numbers and will list it as an open item in the close memo [2].
